note: Trigger-routing suite, minted 2026-07-26 with the skill (issue #97). expect=trigger: a CONSUMER repo holds references to retired plugin/skill/agent/command names and wants them found or fixed. expect=no-trigger: near-misses owned elsewhere — choosing a new name (naming-rules), executing a rename inside the plugin repo (big-change-git-rules), general repo drift (clean-repo), and the routing/description tier (check-routing). The dangerous confusion this suite exists to measure is fix-old-names vs big-change-git-rules: both are about renames, but one runs in the repo that PERFORMED the rename and the other in a repo that merely CONSUMES it.
